register.labelZh: BE / GET 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: BE / GET Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: bogged down 可以描述車輛陷住,也可以描述項目因過多細節而無法推進。；carried away 表示某人過度興奮或投入,以致做得過火或失去分寸。；caught up in 可以描述某人意外受到交通、人群、爭執或其他情況影響。；banged up 是談論入獄的較口語說法;bombed out 則常用於戰爭、歷史和住所遭轟炸的情境。
register.summaryEn: Bogged down can describe a vehicle that cannot move or a project that has become trapped in too many details. Carried away shows that someone becomes so excited or interested that they do too much or forget to control themselves. Caught up in can describe people affected by traffic, crowds, arguments, protests or other situations they did not plan to join. Banged up is an informal way to talk about imprisonment. Bombed out is often used when discussing wars, history and homes destroyed by bombing.

I got carried away.
